title: Journey 3 — Deal with no lead → won without a quotation → Accounts → contract number

steps.do: [BDM] Sales → Opportunities → "+ New opportunity": Name "Kiln shell inspection — PO received", Customer (typed), Value 3,00,000 → "Open the opportunity".
steps.expect: "Opportunity OPP-… opened." "This deal is at Qualified." The Quotes tab says the customer "is not on the client master yet — that is fine" — there is no yellow warning. (Fixed 13 Nov 2026.)
steps.observed: "Opportunity OPP-2026-0001 opened." "This deal is at Enquiry received." Quotes tab: "Kiln Works Pvt Ltd is not on the client master yet — that is fine"; no yellow warning.
steps.note: The deal starts at the default funnel's first stage: "This deal is at Enquiry received." (Inspection profile), not "Qualified".

steps.do: [BDM] "Move it on" → stage "Won (100%) — closes it as a sale" → "Move it".
steps.expect: "Won — <customer> said yes. Next: add the customer to the master (Actions tab), then send it to Accounts to register the contract."
steps.observed: "Won — Kiln Works Pvt Ltd said yes. Next: add the customer to the master (Actions tab), then send it to Accounts to register the contract."

steps.do: [BDM] Read the yellow box on the deal.
steps.expect: "It has no customer on the master yet, so an order has nowhere to point. Add them as a customer first." Below it: Customer name (already filled), State, and "＋ Add as a customer" — and, as before, "Or pick one already on the master" + "Set the customer".
steps.observed: Yellow box: "It has no customer on the master yet… Add them as a customer first." with Customer name (filled "Kiln Works Pvt Ltd"), State and "＋ Add as a customer"; also "Or pick one already on the master" + "Set the customer".

steps.do: [BDM] Type State "Maharashtra" → "＋ Add as a customer".
steps.expect: "<Name> is now a customer (C-…). Next: send the deal to Accounts to register the contract. The customer record is short — GSTIN or PAN, address and e-mail are completed before the first work order." The top line: "Next: on the Actions tab, send it to Accounts to register the contract." (Fixed 13 Nov 2026 — there used to be no way to add the customer from here.)
steps.observed: "Kiln Works Pvt Ltd is now a customer (C-KILNWORK-0009). Next: send the deal to Accounts to register the contract. The customer record is short — GSTIN or PAN, address and e-mail are completed before t"; top line "Next: on the Actions tab, send it to Accounts to register the contract."
steps.note: Message reads: "Kiln Works Pvt Ltd is now a customer (C-KILNWORK-0009). Next: send the deal to Accounts to register the contract. The customer record is short — GSTIN or PAN, address and e-mail are completed before the first inspection call."

steps.do: [BDM] Tab "Actions" → "Send to Accounts to register the contract".
steps.expect: "Sent to Accounts — they will register the contract for this deal, and the order opens to operations once it is approved. Nothing more for Sales to do here."
steps.observed: "Sent to Accounts — they will register the contract for this deal, and the order opens to operations once it is approved. Nothing more for Sales to do here."

steps.do: [Finance] Dashboard → task "won deals to register" (or "Register" on the panel "N won deals without a quote are waiting for a contract").
steps.expect: Screen "Contracts to register": the deal with its reference, name, customer and agreed value, and one button "✓ Register the contract — next number". Accepted quotations waiting for a number are listed below it. (Fixed 13 Nov 2026 — "Register" used to open the deal page: "Sales & CRM — restricted".)
steps.observed: task "won deals to register" → "Contracts to register": OPP-2026-0001, the name, Kiln Works Pvt Ltd, ₹3,00,000 and "✓ Register the contract — next number".

steps.do: [Finance] "✓ Register the contract — next number".
steps.expect: Stays on Contracts to register. "Contract AHM/C/2026-27/0000N registered — it is waiting for approval. Waiting for the first signature — <names>. Then the final approval — <names>. The work orders are raised from it once it is open." The deal has left the list.
steps.observed: Stayed on Contracts to register: "Contract AHM/C/2026-27/00001 registered — it is waiting for approval. Waiting for the first signature — Test BAM, Test BranchMgr, Test Director and 3 more. Then the final approval — Test BAM, Test BranchMgr, Test BranchMgr2. The inspection calls are raised from it once it is open."; the deal left the list.

steps.do: [BDM] Open the deal.
steps.expect: "The contract is registered and waiting for approval; then the orders are raised from it." with the contract number and who it waits for.
steps.observed: "The contract is registered and waiting for approval; then the orders are raised from it." with AHM/C/2026-27/00001 and the signers named.

steps.do: [Operation Manager] then [Branch Manager] sign from Contract openings.
steps.expect: Contract OPEN. The deal reads "The contract is registered and open — the orders are raised from it." It has left Finance's "won deals" panel.
steps.observed: Contract AHM/C/2026-27/00001 OPEN; the deal reads "The contract is registered and open — the orders are raised from it."; Finance's won-deals panel no longer counts it.

steps.do: [Coordinator] Dashboard.
steps.expect: A task: "contract opened — raise the work order". It opens the work-order form filled in from the contract (several contracts: the list "Newly opened — no work order raised yet", one "▶ Raise work order" each). (New 13 Nov 2026.)
steps.observed: Task "contract opened — raise the inspection call" opens the order form filled in from AHM/C/2026-27/00001 (Kiln Works Pvt Ltd).

steps.do: EDGE · Register the same deal a second time.
steps.expect: Refused — a deal cannot be registered to a second contract.
steps.observed: Refused: "A contract has already been registered for this deal."

steps.do: EDGE · Type a contract number that another customer already uses.
steps.expect: Refused — a number identifies one contract.
steps.observed: Typing AHM/C/2026-27/00001 (Kiln Works' number) for TB Valves is refused: "Contract number AHM/C/2026-27/00001 is already registered against Kiln Works Pvt Ltd. A contract number must identify one contract."

steps.do: EDGE · [BDM] Try "Send to Accounts" before a customer is set.
steps.expect: The button is not offered until the customer is on the master.
steps.observed: No "Send to Accounts" button while the deal has no customer on the master.

steps.do: EDGE · [Finance] On Contracts to register open "Enter it differently" → type the client's own number, Start and End dates → "Register with these details".
steps.expect: The contract carries that number and those dates.
steps.observed: Registered as PHARMA/PO/7781 from 2026-11-15 to 2027-11-15 ("Contract PHARMA/PO/7781 registered — it is waiting for approval. Waiting for the").

steps.do: EDGE · [Finance] Try to open the deal itself (/opportunity?id=…).
steps.expect: Still "Sales & CRM — restricted" — Finance registers the contract without needing the deal, and cannot change a deal.
steps.observed: "Sales & CRM — restricted You don’t have permission to open Leads & pipeline. Ask your work"

steps.do: EDGE · [BDM] "＋ Add as a customer" with a name that a customer on the master already has.
steps.expect: It stops once: "A customer with this name is already on file: C-… — <name>. If it is the same company, pick it from the list below. If it really is a different company, tick "It is a different company" and press again." A tick-box appears; ticking it and pressing again adds the new customer on purpose.
steps.observed: Stopped once: "A customer with this name is already on file: C-KILNWORK-0009 — Kiln Works Pvt Ltd. If it is the same company, pick it f…"; the tick-box appeared; ticked + pressed again → "Kiln Works Pvt Ltd is now a customer (C-KILNWORK-0010). Next" (2 customers with that name).

steps.do: EDGE · [BDM] Press "＋ Add as a customer" twice (two tabs).
steps.expect: One customer only; the second press says the deal already has its customer.
steps.observed: One customer only; first tab "Two Tabs Traders is now a customer (C-TWOTABST-001…", second tab "This deal already has its customer."

steps.do: EDGE · A one-off job with no contract.
steps.expect: On the won deal, "Or raise a work order directly — a one-off with no contract — set the rate on the order" (folded). The deal then reads "The work order is raised — open it from this deal."
steps.observed: Folded "Or raise a work order directly…" raised the order ("Order CALL-00001 raised, with no quotation attached — set th"); the deal reads "The work order is raised — open it. Over" (the test's wording adds "from this deal").
steps.note: The fold is not offered to the BDM (only to someone who may raise operations orders — here the administrator); the step does not say who.
steps.suggest: [Coordinator / manager who raises orders] On the won deal, "Or raise a work order directly…"

steps.do: EDGE · Traceability wanted later.
steps.expect: "＋ Generate quotation" on the won deal drafts a quotation-of-record for it (one only).
steps.observed: "Quotation Q-00001 generated as a draft — finish the lines and rate here, then it is on record for th" — one quotation-of-record; the button is gone afterwards.

steps.do: EDGE · The company's contract rule is "None".
steps.expect: The contract is open the moment it is registered; no signer is asked (SAL-179).
steps.observed: Rule "None": registered and OPEN at once — "Contract AHM/C/2026-27/00002 registered and open — your company asks for no approval to open a contr"
